guard: help, the entry screen and a failure written to a real terminal fit its width: lines wrap at spaces with each continuation under its text, a usage option keeps its value, and a flag column too wide for its descriptions puts each description under its flag
why: Only a real terminal reports a width, so only the pty suite can show help and failures read it. The binary imports the CLI package through its build, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: help keeps a description beside a flag column too wide for it
mutations.expectRed: on 60 columns a flag description goes under its flag
mutations.cell: on 60 columns a flag description goes under its flag

mutations.name: a usage line breaks inside an option
mutations.expectRed: on 80 columns its usage wraps only between options
mutations.cell: on 80 columns its usage wraps only between options

mutations.name: the help footer is not wrapped
mutations.find: for (const note of notes) out += `\n${hang("", note, width, c.dim).join("\n")}`;
mutations.expectRed: cotal help on a 80-column terminal fits every line
mutations.cell: cotal help on a 80-column terminal fits every line

mutations.name: help ignores the terminal's width
mutations.expectRed: cotal help spawn on a 80-column terminal fits every line
mutations.cell: cotal help spawn on a 80-column terminal fits every line

mutations.name: a failure line is written unwrapped
mutations.find: for (const line of hang(prefix, text, terminalWidth(process.stderr))) console.error(paint(line));
mutations.expectRed: a failure on a 40-column terminal wraps under its text
mutations.cell: a failure on a 40-column terminal wraps under its text
